1.label: very_easy
1.summary: Two wide moving layers, slow approach and responsive steering.

2.label: easy
2.summary: Smaller apertures and faster changing motion require closer prediction.

3.label: medium
3.summary: Three independent depths compete for two-axis alignment; steering has more inertia.

4.label: hard
4.summary: Four closely spaced layers and a larger range of motion require earlier changes between incompatible alignments.

5.label: very_hard
5.summary: Four narrower layers, faster independent bends and slower damping combine transverse prediction, inertia and loaded withdrawal.

full.summary: Drag the two-axis command handle; Space closes the clamp. Numbered transverse slice buttons reveal the same concealed apertures and retain live tracks; waiting is stable and each deliberate probe control advances one fixed step.

simplified.summary: Click a position on the same command pad; GRIP RELIC closes the clamp. Identical servo, world, timing and clearance. Numbered transverse slice buttons reveal the same concealed apertures and retain live tracks; waiting is stable and each deliberate probe control advances one fixed step.
